# Component Matrix

*This file is auto-generated from the main SigmaOS repository's COMPONENTS.toml*

*Auto-sync status: Waiting for first sync from main repository*

## Overview

This matrix will contain the complete registry of SigmaOS components including:
- Component name and description
- Owner and maintainer
- Current status and stability
- Dependencies and relationships

## Generation

The matrix is automatically generated by the `sync-components.yml` GitHub Action workflow:
1. Triggered on each push to main branch
2. Fetches COMPONENTS.toml from main SigmaOS repo
3. Runs `scripts/generate-components-md.py`
4. Commits changes automatically

## Viewing

Once populated, the matrix will display:

| Component | Category | Owner | Status | Description |
|-----------|----------|-------|--------|-------------|
| (components auto-generated) | ... | ... | ... | ... |

See [README.md](./README.md) for more information.
